title: One Roof to Finish
can_do: 在不想立刻停止时说出感受，并具体说明还需要完成什么。
trigger: Dad announces cleanup while one visible part of the child's block house is unfinished.
core_response: I don't want to stop yet.
stretch_response: I don't want to stop yet. I need to finish the roof.
repair_response: Just the roof, then I can stop.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Cleanup time. Please put the blocks in the box.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I don't want to stop yet.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: What do you still need to finish?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I need to add the roof to my house.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Finish the roof, then the blocks go in the box.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. The roof is on. I am ready to clean up.

replay_cards.title: Finish the picture
replay_cards.change: The last wheel still needs color
replay_cards.challenge: Mom calls for bath time; name the one visible part to finish, finish it, and go

replay_cards.title: End the train game
replay_cards.change: The train is one stop from the station
replay_cards.challenge: Dad calls for lunch; state the boundary, name the last stop, arrive, and put the train away

parent_support: Ask what remains instead of guessing.
Agree only to a short, visible finish point and calmly keep the cleanup boundary.
